readme:
# Kununu Employer Reviews Scraper

Scrape employer reviews, ratings, salaries, and benefits from [kununu.com](https://www.kununu.com), the largest employer review platform in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland with over 15 million reviews.

## How it works

1. Enter a company name or industry keyword (e.g., "SAP", "Software Zurich")
2. Choose a country: Germany (`de`), Austria (`at`), or Switzerland (`ch`)
3. Run the actor

The actor finds matching companies and extracts their full employer profile including scores, salary data, benefits, and more.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/kununu-de-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `kununu-de-scraper` to scrape company data from kununu de. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `name` / `slug` | Company name and URL slug |
| `logo_url` | Company logo |
| `score` / `rounded_score` | Overall score (1-5) |
| `total_reviews` | Number of reviews |
| `recommendation_rate` | Percentage who recommend the employer |
| `industry` / `location` | Company industry and location |
| `score_breakdown` | 14 factor scores (salary, atmosphere, leadership, etc.) |
| `benefits` | 20+ benefit types with percentages |
| `salary_ranges` | Per job title: min, max, median, average |
| `awards` | Top Company badges by year |
| `competitors` | Related companies with scores |
| `source_url` | Link to company on kununu.com |

## Pricing

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Start | $0.050 per run |
| Company (SERP) | $0.003 per result |
| Company (full profile) | $0.005 per result |

**100 companies = $0.55** (full profile)

## Examples

### Search by company name
```json
{
  "searchQuery": "SAP",
  "country": "de",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Multiple searches
```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["Software Zurich", "Beratung Berlin", "Automotive Munich"],
  "country": "de",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 30
}
```

### Direct company URLs
```json
{
  "directUrls": [
    "https://www.kununu.com/de/sap",
    "https://www.kununu.com/at/sap-oesterreich",
    "https://www.kununu.com/ch/sap-schweiz12"
  ]
}
```
